newsitem.title: USA: Kmart stores to use Sensormatic.
newsitem.headline: Kmart stores to use Sensormatic.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said on Thursday that Kmart will accelerate merchandise tagging in the remaining 1,019 Kmart locations in the United States with Sensormatic's Ultramax technology.
Under the terms of the agreement, Sensormatic will install and retain ownership of its UltraMax systems through Jan. 1, 2002.
Sensormatic's total installed base of UltraMax at Kmart will increase to 2,119 locations in the United States as a result of the agreement.
Kmart will purchase from Sensormatic its entire requirements for UltraMax labels and tags designed to prevent theft, Sensormatic said.

Sensormatic and Kmart will form a joint source tagging task force to accelerate the process of source tagging with Kmart's vendors in all product categories, including apparel, health and beauty care items as well as food products, Sensormatic said.
Sensormatic is not disclosing the dollar amount of the deal, but the contract will be profitable for the company, a company spokeswoman said.
Kmart offices were closed and unavailable for comment.
